entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that offers a universal memory layer for AI Agents. It supports multi-level memory for User, Session, and Agent states through temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider featuring a custom vector graph engine and sub-300ms recall. It automates fact extraction and user profile maintenance while supporting multi-modal extractors for various file types.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that unifies agent memories and skills using a filesystem management paradigm. It utilizes tiered L0/L1/L2 loading to reduce token consumption and supports directory recursive retrieval.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: A brain for the Hermes Agent that provides synthesized answers accompanied by citations and gap analysis. It employs a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed edges and supports local or remote deployments.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system designed for long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It is available via Python and Node.js client SDKs and supports Docker-based deployment.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that supports peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is available as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that treats memory as a git repository using brv vc versioning. It features an interactive TUI and supports 20 LLM providers and 24 built-in agent tools.
entries.AxDSan/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency, sub-millisecond memory system backed by SQLite. It is compatible with MCP clients and includes a TripleStore for temporal knowledge graph management.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that generates persistent playbooks and hints from task runs. It distills successful behaviors into local-model training artifacts and exports CLI-first skills for Hermes integration.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a SQLite message store with FTS metadata. It provides agent tools for searching and expanding compacted material and supports optional sensitive pattern redaction.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend for Honcho that enables private cross-session memory for the Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes a Docker setup script.
entries.plur-ai/plur: A shared memory layer for multi-agent systems that stores memory as plain-text YAML engrams on disk. It supports hierarchical scoping for global and project-specific knowledge.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: A local-first layer for identity, memory, and secrets that provides portable state across multiple agent harnesses. It includes a dedicated dashboard for inspecting and repairing memory.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: An on-device, local-first memory and context engine with no cloud dependencies or API keys. It uses hybrid retrieval via vector search and multi-graph traversal with a shared SQLite vault.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: A plugin that optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication for prefix reuse. It reduces prefill latency and saves tokens, offering native support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: A durable, file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search. It is a local-first architecture that does not require a vector database or embeddings.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: A self-maintaining plugin that provides explainable recall via why_retrieved tags. It includes contradiction tracking and a built-in outcome ledger for agent-authored skills.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: A memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by watching agent session logs. It uses local-first storage via SQLite-vec and provides an MCP-native server.
entries.keepnotes-ai/keep: A reflective memory system featuring semantic search with BM25 and ranked graph traversal. It provides automated indexing for codebases and multimedia with OCR support.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: A tool to reduce Hermes Agent tool-schema overhead through keyword selection and tool search. It uses local BM25 tool ranking to reduce prompt token overhead.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: A memory and context layer that resolves live workspace state into verified facts. It aims to reduce prompt tokens by loading only the necessary context through configuration files.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only plugin that uses an embedded graph database and BM25-first retrieval. It features an importance ranking to surface high-priority memories during context prefetch.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: A long-term, cross-project memory system that stores data as inspectable Markdown files. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and is daemonless.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that supports real, immediate event deletion. It provides an audit trace of prefetch operations via a trace.jsonl log.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: A memory provider that offers durable cross-session AI memory with semantic search. It supports automatic memory mirroring and session snapshots with TTL support.
entries.piprail/piprail: An SDK and MCP server that enables AI agents to pay for API usage using various blockchain families. It integrates with Hermes and OpenClaw to support multiple chain families.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: A memory plugin that integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term agent memory. It provides tools for searching, manual storage, and configurable query expansion.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: A plugin providing private local code memory for repositories via semantic search and file reads. It requires a local SourceVault server and supports slash commands.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: A memory provider featuring 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It uses hybrid search methods and provides automatic context checkpointing.

entries.obra/superpowers: An agentic skills framework and software development methodology utilizing a subagent-driven-development process. It includes skills for brainstorming and planning while emphasizing red/green TDD and YAGNI.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first open-source design and prototyping system that supports HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 exports. It features coding-agent CLI support and is compatible with various coding agents and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: A collection of 817 production-grade cybersecurity skills mapped to six major frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. These skills cover 29 security domains and are compatible with 26+ AI platforms.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: A tool for generating draw.io diagrams from natural language descriptions using 11 diagram type presets. It converts Mermaid text into editable files and includes self-check and auto-fix capabilities.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: An auditing and rewriting tool designed to eliminate detectable AI writing patterns. It uses a two-pass detection system and a 111-entry word replacement table to support agents like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: A system for collective skill evolution that provides automated deduplication and quality improvement. It enables unified skill libraries across multiple agents and shared user teams.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform skills library compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents. It contains 50 expert frameworks and 12 metaskills designed to orchestrate business and code journeys.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: A trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce providing adjudication for deals. It includes natural-language mandates, escrow, dispute resolution, and various payment protocols.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation for detected patterns.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: Provides type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI through filesystem-based or programmatic Python definitions. It uses progressive disclosure of skill metadata to reduce token usage.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: A suite of skills for extracting YouTube transcripts, captions, and timestamps without using yt-dlp. It supports video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction for various AI agents.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: A skill set that enables the dynamic generation of custom analytical lenses via /prism-scan. It includes seven pre-built prisms and a /prism-reflect command for identifying analysis blind spots.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: A workflow skill that converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes alongside a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: A harness for long-running AI agents that provides structured memory and a three-level work model. It supports file-backed and SQLite-backed cards and includes a CLI for task management.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: A literate programming skill that weaves code and documentation into.lit.md files. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the document.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: A plugin for self-memory and replacement models that uses markdown files for cross-instance shared memory. It automates the capture of high-value decisions to facilitate fine-tuning replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: An implementation of the agentskills.io specification for interacting with oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds integration.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: Official image generation skills for the FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 model families. It provides standardized prompting guidelines, JSON structured prompting, and API integration patterns.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: A tool that converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It provides provenance via file:line citations or documentation URLs.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: A registry for reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification. It includes a Python SkilldockClient, a CLI, and commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: A skill for autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks. It provides real-time progress tracking and built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage. It uses a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incremental metadata discovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: A skill for managing Nextcloud files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: A workflow language for AI implemented as a single Rust binary under the AGPL-3.0 license. It features static auditing for cost, secrets, and types, and provides hash-chained execution receipts.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: A five-layer intelligent skill retrieval system that uses hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion. It reduces token usage by narrowing skill lists before LLM calls.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: A plugin that rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites based on model family and tracks quality scores in a local SQLite database.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: An adversarial code review skill that uses three parallel subagents to analyze edge cases and exploitability. It integrates Semgrep, Bandit, and Gosec for deterministic pre-scanning.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C# /.NET implementation of agentskills.io with MCP integration. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and automatic registration of common skill directories.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: A skill that implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It provides a systematic investigation protocol and a Python goal engine for state management.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: A multi-agent code simplification skill using a three-agent swarm targeting hygiene, clarity, and correctness. It includes a risk-tiered triage system for safe code modifications.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A community hub for browsing, searching, and one-click installation of skills. It implements the Agentic Resource Discovery v0.9 specification and features federated search integration.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: A CLI and MCP server that allows users to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and plugins.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: A skill that automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC. It is compatible with OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: A multi-scale Chinese news briefing generator that produces structured reports from global to street level. It includes quality gates, AI analysis, and semantic memory for user interests.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, with support for both binary and source-based installations. It features daily automated updates for all included packages and includes agents from providers such as Google and OpenAI.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository contains scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, including Hermes Agent, on Android smartphones via Termux. It provides an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 and configuration guides for running OpenClaw using Termux:API and Termux:GUI.
entries.rookiemann/portable-hermes-agent: This is a zero-install Windows desktop agent that requires no admin rights and operates without Docker. It features a GUI, an integrated workflow engine for automated multi-step pipelines, and an extensive toolset including TTS, Music, and ComfyUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This project offers an automated Termux-based installer and guide for running Hermes Agent on Android devices. It supports local model execution via Ollama and is compatible with providers like OpenAI and Anthropic.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart enables deployment on Kubernetes with cloud-native state-safety guardrails for persistent HERMES_HOME storage. It supports direct deployment or operator-ready CRD-based workflows and offers a configurable gateway mode with optional API and webhook listeners.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project provides hardware-level enforcement for Hermes Agent sandboxing via NVIDIA OpenShell. It utilizes kernel-level restrictions for network and filesystem access and allows for configurable security policies regarding messaging and web search.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for building specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployment through declarative configuration of workspace documents and cli-config.yaml. It features hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via sops-nix and systemd EnvironmentFiles.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane is designed to deploy, monitor, and operate OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps, and includes a REST API, CLI, and MCP server.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate identities and workspaces through a single web application. It features hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, task scheduling, and enterprise MCP access for external AI client integrations.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project enables production-ready, headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers by configuring Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It supports the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework decomposes financial trading tasks into specialized analyst and researcher roles. It is designed for research purposes and includes dedicated agents for risk and portfolio management.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform supports task dispatching, multi-agent workflows, and spend monitoring via Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API. It features a memory browser, relationship graph, and views for execution review and costs.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides TUI and PWA dashboards for monitoring multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It enables parallel execution across multi-repo workspaces and git worktrees using Docker, Podman, or Apple Containers for sandboxing.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template utilizes a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single VPS agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for registry management, security auditing, and VPS setup.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This control room template uses a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agent from single agents to automated teams. It provides bundled skills for backup management, security auditing, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms using multiple model providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.Agent-3-7/minions: This mission control interface allows users to create, supervise, and review autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution alongside human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols for local communication and tool handling, featuring a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for code, tasks, and scoreboard metrics.
entries.Rainhoole/hermes-agent-acp-skill: This system routes tasks between Hermes subagents, Codex, and Claude Code using ACP-style delegation. It prevents parent context pollution through isolated workflows and enforces safety via output character limits and configurable timeouts.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: Provides a local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph via an MCP server to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. This tool supports Windows, macOS, and Linux with an auto-syncing local index.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A CLI tool featuring a native Rust TUI for high-performance local monitoring of token usage and costs. It supports integrations for Hermes Agent alongside other AI coding agents.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: A local trace viewer used to inspect coding-agent API traffic, including system prompts, tool calls, and streaming responses. It allows users to compare adjacent requests and export self-contained HTML trace artifacts.
entries.bergside/typeui: Offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in UI construction. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown or general prompting and integrates with Hermes Agent.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents to build, ship, and operate applications. It includes 36 skills and supports autonomous execution on laptops or a VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: A community CLI tool for customizing the Hermes terminal UI with custom banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art. It utilizes YAML-based configuration for creating diverse themes like cyberpunk or retro DOS.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: A social economy for autonomous agents that provides encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It facilitates commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments and supports identity registration with @handles.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: A port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively within CCC without external processes or OAuth and includes MLOps tools for RL training and inference.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control via MCP. It features a visible UI for real-time supervision and includes session management and an integrated research desk.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: A TAW Agent framework that enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder local configuration and skills. It allows for seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local memories.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: A setup featuring preconfigured skills and token-saving CLI workflows designed to achieve 90-99% token savings. It includes over 40 skills for research, devops, and finance with automated installation for Linux and macOS.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: An automated installation tool that deploys a hermes-agent stack and 12+ supporting services in minutes. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and support for 29 community plugins.
entries.roli-lpci/lintlang: A static linter for scanning AI agent configs, tool descriptions, and system prompts without using LLM calls. It uses seven structural detectors to identify common agent failure modes across various file formats.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: A migration tool designed to transfer OpenClaw personas, memories, skills, and workspace files to Hermes Agent. It maps OpenClaw model configurations to Hermes YAML format and handles credential transfers.
entries.observeco/observeco: A self-healing observability tool for monitoring and auto-recovering multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It includes a beta Hermes plugin for exporting telemetry and tracking token intelligence for cost and memory bloat.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Gemini CLI, and Hermes Agent. It is built with Tauri 2 to provide efficient desktop performance on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local open-source cowork app that unifies multiple CLI agents, including Hermes Agent and OpenClaw, into a single interface. It features a built-in agent engine with zero configuration and automates document creation for Word, Excel, and PPT.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A web-based interface that provides full parity with the Hermes CLI experience. It utilizes a three-panel layout with workspace file browsing and supports secure remote access via SSH tunneling.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed for installing, configuring, and chatting with Hermes Agent. It provides a GUI for managing sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers through a guided setup process.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-web-ui: A web dashboard featuring multi-platform AI chat, session management, and usage analytics. It includes a file browser, web terminal, and unified configuration for channels like Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace that integrates a chat interface, terminal, memory browser, skills manager, and inspector panel. It supports Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native macOS workspace that enables direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It includes embedded terminal access for system repair and native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension that connects active browser contexts to local, Hermes Cloud, or remote gateways. It provides a full-page Hermes Web workspace for Chrome, Edge, and Chromium.
entries.Eynzof/hermes-agent-cn-desktop: A Windows-first desktop application built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust that supports both Windows and macOS. It includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core runtime and supports Markdown and LaTeX rendering.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard providing a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and session overview. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS application for browsing sessions and acting as an agent cockpit. It provides transcript inspection, image browsing, and tracks per-session costs and quota burn-rates for Hermes and other CLIs.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS workspace designed for running Hermes Agent on SSH hosts and Orgo cloud computers. It features one-click automated installation and integrated WebRTC voice mode via Orgo MCP.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative Hermes TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI. It consolidates chat, sessions, and configuration into a terminal dashboard with integrated kanban boards and an extensible Eikon avatar system.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A React-based SPA dashboard designed as a mobile-first Telegram Mini App. It supports terminal chat with streaming responses, file attachments, and background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable, no-install Windows desktop application that requires no admin rights or Docker. It includes 100 tools, such as TTS and ComfyUI, and a workflow engine for multi-step automation pipelines.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface for self-hosted Hermes Agent chat and real-time log streaming. It includes a task tracking dashboard, file browser, and management tools for MCP servers, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A configuration and process monitoring dashboard for Hermes. It provides real-time tracking of session activity and costs, alongside read-only inspection of environment variables, configuration, and skill source code.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted AI workspace featuring chat with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, alongside isolated profile management for API keys and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A multi-agent desktop client that orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and a native interface for streaming SSE responses.
